name: Deploy preview when review reaches the goal (Cloudflare)
description: Hourly on weekdays, list open pull requests whose ProPR review reached its goal, with the /deploy-cloudflare command for each. Existing Cloudflare previews are not checked.

reviewBeforeSaving.note: Choose the repositories deployed with Cloudflare; use the same repositories as the plugin's limit.
Runs at minute 0 of every hour from 09:00 to 17:00 UTC, Monday to Friday. Each run reads pull requests only; it never deploys.
Starts as Dry run. This template only reports: raising the mode creates nothing, because a deploy needs a person with write permission to run /deploy-cloudflare.
